scope: gfx1151 Poolside Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M BF16-KV p512/d128 eager c=1 argmax-owned next-control publication

design.host_contract: reuse only when the next forward position and supplied token exactly match the previous synchronized argmax result
design.forced_token_fallback: copy the forced token while adopting the independently valid prepublished position
design.unfused_fallback: top1_i64 plus three synchronous H2D scalar publications

correctness.primitive: candidate top-1 id and FP32 value bits equal the retained stage-2 reduction, including minimum-index ties
correctness.control_values: token and both int64 positions equal the requested next state

same_resident_gate.protocol: seven counterbalanced p512/d128 control/candidate pairs, one shared 79.1-GB resident owner, 127 synchronized forward_token calls per arm

trace.protocol: one require-cached rocprofv3 p512/d128 process after a non-profiled cache warmup

commands.same_resident: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 7 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --compare-argmax-control-publish --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-argmax-publish-ab7.json
commands.trace: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-directory /tmp/laguna-argmax-publish-trace --output-file argmax-publish --output-format csv -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-argmax-publish-trace.json

decision: retain and default on gfx1151; preserve ordinary argmax and host publication as explicit constructor and registry fallback
